title: Molecular functions of the double-sided and inverted ubiquitin-interacting motif found in Xenopus tropicalis cryptochrome 6.
authors: Okano, Keiko; Otsuka, Hiroaki; Nakagawa, Marika; Okano, Toshiyuki
one_liner_zh: 该文研究非洲爪蟾隐花色素6中双面倒置泛素互作基序的结构预测与泛素结合模拟，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作模拟，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Cryptochromes (CRYs) are multifunctional molecules that act as a circadian clock oscillating factor, a blue-light sensor, and a light-driven magnetoreceptor. Cry genes are classified into several groups based on the evolutionary relationships. Cryptochrome 6 gene (Cry6) is present in invertebrates and lower vertebrates such as amphibians and fishes. Here we identified a Cry6 ortholog in Xenopus tropicalis (XtCry6). XtCRY6 retains a conserved long N-terminal extension (termed CRY N-terminal extension; CNE) that is not found in any CRY in the other groups. A structural prediction suggested that CNE contained unique structures; a tetrahelical fold structure topologically related to KaiA/RbsU domain, overlapping nuclear- and nucleolar-localizing signals (NLS/NoLS), and a novel motif (termed DI-UIM) overlapping a double-sided ubiquitin-interacting motif (DUIM) and an inverted ubiquitin-interacting motif (IUIM). Potential activities of the NLS/NoLS and DI-UIM were examined to infer the molecular function of XtCRY6. GFP-NLS/NoLS fusion protein exogenously expressed in HEK293 cells was mostly observed in the nucleolus, while GFP-XtCRY6 was observed in the cytoplasm. A glutathione S-transferase (GST) pull-down assay suggested that the DI-UIM physically interacts with polyubiquitin. Consistently, protein docking simulations implied that XtCRY6 DI-UIM binds two ubiquitin molecules in a relationship of a twofold rotational symmetry with the symmetry axis parallel or perpendicular to the DI-UIM helix. These results strongly suggested that XtCRY6 does not function as a circadian transcriptional repressor and that it might have another function such as photoreceptive molecule regulating light-dependent protein degradation or gene expression through a CNE-mediated interaction with ubiquitinated proteins in the cytoplasm and/or nucleolus.
abstract_zh: 隐花色素（Cryptochromes, CRYs）是一类多功能分子，充当昼夜节律时钟振荡因子、蓝光传感器以及光驱动磁受体。基于进化关系，Cry基因被分为若干组。隐花色素6基因（Cry6）存在于无脊椎动物和低等脊椎动物（如两栖类和鱼类）中。本研究在热带爪蟾（Xenopus tropicalis）中鉴定出一个Cry6直系同源物（XtCry6）。XtCRY6保留了一个保守的长N端延伸（称为CRY N端延伸；CNE），该延伸在其他任何组的CRY中均未发现。结构预测表明，CNE包含独特结构：一个与KaiA/RbsU结构域拓扑相关的四螺旋折叠结构，重叠的核定位信号和核仁定位信号（NLS/NoLS），以及一个新颖基序（称为DI-UIM），该基序重叠双面泛素相互作用基序（DUIM）和反向泛素相互作用基序（IUIM）。为推断XtCRY6的分子功能，对NLS/NoLS和DI-UIM的潜在活性进行了检测。在HEK293细胞中外源表达的GFP-NLS/NoLS融合蛋白主要定位于核仁，而GFP-XtCRY6则定位于细胞质。谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）下拉实验表明，DI-UIM与多聚泛素发生物理相互作用。一致地，蛋白质对接模拟暗示XtCRY6 DI-UIM以二重旋转对称关系结合两个泛素分子，对称轴平行或垂直于DI-UIM螺旋。这些结果强烈表明，XtCRY6不作为昼夜节律转录抑制因子发挥作用，而可能具有其他功能，例如作为感光分子，通过CNE介导的与细胞质和/或核仁中泛素化蛋白的相互作用，调节光依赖性蛋白质降解或基因表达。
